{{Top|leg}}
A '''harem''' was part of a [[Noehon]] [[Weld]]. It consisted of 10 to 50 subservient females under the authority of an [[Alpha (Noehon)|alpha]]. The females had a strict hierarchy where the oldest or longest held females led the younger or newer females.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies">[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]</ref>
